name: Ordun Tarnes
found: Tarnes Granary, or walking the barley fields alone at dawn.
appearance: Weathered, patient, soil under his nails.
wants: Good harvests and peace with all parties.
does_not_want: The village learning of his quiet negotiations.
dreams: A worthy heir for what he knows.
oddly_also: One of the few who knows the lizard-man compact, and keeps it.
family: Tarnes patriarch; an extended family of fifteen and more.
dm_notes: He trades barley to the lizard-men each harvest to keep the compact.
